name: Amira Al-Hassan
text: Prima completely transformed my relationship with food. Within six months I went from home cook to sous chef at a respected restaurant. The instructors genuinely care about your growth.
outcome: Now Sous Chef at Zuma Dubai

name: Kwame Asante
text: James is an exceptional teacher. The hands-on bar sessions and his storytelling around each spirit made the course unforgettable. I launched my pop-up bar within months.

name: Sara Dimitriou
text: Nadia doesn't just teach makeup — she teaches professionalism. My portfolio opened doors I never imagined. I'm now working fashion weeks across the region.
outcome: Freelance MUA — Dubai & Cairo Fashion Weeks

name: Linh Nguyen
text: The pattern-making module alone was worth the entire programme. Yuki has an incredible eye and helped me develop my own aesthetic language. Truly world-class teaching.

name: Tariq Mansour
text: Elena's passion for coffee is infectious. The sensory training sessions were eye-opening — I can never drink coffee the same way again. My café opened 3 months after graduating.

name: Isabelle Moreau
text: Sophie's technical precision pushed me to levels I didn't think possible. The chocolate and sugar arts module was pure magic. Every week I was amazed at what I could create.
outcome: Head Pastry Chef, Four Seasons Beirut
